_readme: Copy this file to data/places-cache.json, then replace these examples with businesses you verified yourself.
Give accurate 'lat'/'lng' for placement. If you only supply an address, PAI Places geocodes it (town-level addresses land at the town centroid and may fall outside a small radius).
OpenStreetMap is often empty in rural areas. This cache is the supported way to add those businesses without using Google Maps or RapidAPI.
Record businesses you verified yourself. Do not paste listing data copied out of a commercial map provider.
This file is gitignored once copied to places-cache.json.

places.name: Example Auto Shop
places.notes: Replace with a business you verified. Coordinates are what place it in search results.

places.name: Example Equine Facility
places.notes: No coordinates supplied, so PAI Places geocodes the address. Prefer lat/lng when you know them.
